name: p4-skillex
description: Watches what a project's sessions write inside <project>/.claude/p4/temportal/ and turns the scripts they keep writing again into skills, each at <project>/.claude/p4/skillex/<skill_name>/SKILL.md. Only after a skill is written does it search for a similar skill that already exists, and it links the new skill to it. Every store skill is copied into the project's .claude/skills/ so each session of the project is offered it. It holds what a project would otherwise install a third-party plugin or MCP server for, shaped to that project's work.
